// The intersection of two 3D primitives: a flag plus the discrete
// intersection points (empty when Intersects is false, or when the overlap
// is a curve or region rather than isolated points).
type IntersectionResult3D
    implements IValue
{
    Intersects: Boolean;
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
}
